visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a bustling sidewalk in front of a bright yellow food stall named '香香飯糰'. A woman with short auburn hair wearing a blue quilted vest and black trousers stands in the foreground, facing away from the camera. In front of her, three men are queued at the counter; one wears a black hoodie with 'PRIDE' text, another a blue shirt and a cap, and a third in a black jacket. The stall has a large yellow banner with cartoon monkey graphics. (2) The camera transitions to a series of medium close-ups of food trays behind glass. Various colorful ingredients are displayed: bright green broccoli, sliced ham, fried sausages, and marinated meats. Each tray has a small white price tag or name tag with black text. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor-outdoor food market. (3) A hand wearing a red long-sleeved shirt points toward the selection through the glass. The camera then cuts to a close-up of a worker's hands, wearing a black glove, using a metal spoon to scoop chopped egg and other toppings into a mound of rice placed on a piece of clear plastic wrap. The background shows more containers of corn and pickled vegetables. (4) An extreme close-up features a large, cylindrical rice ball held in a hand. It is wrapped in plastic and reveals a striking contrast between white rice and dark purple rice. The rice ball is then sliced in half by an off-screen person, showing a dense interior packed with green vegetables, brown meat, and yellow egg pieces. (5) Another close-up shows a different rice ball variant composed of purple rice and light brown unpolished rice. It is held up against a blurry outdoor background. This rice ball is also cut open to reveal a filling of stir-fried greens and meat. (6) A hand holds a tall, tan-colored plastic cup filled with a beverage, likely milk tea, sealed with a clear film. The background shows the tiled wall of the stall. (7) The camera pans out and up to show the storefront of '香香飯糰' with its address '高雄市三民區鼎中路210號' clearly printed on a yellow sign. The final shot is a low-angle view looking up at vertical oval signboards attached to the side of a brick building, each displaying one character of the stall's name.
